messages:
alex: Heads up — customer AcmeCorp reported a p99 latency spike on chat API from ~120ms -> ~420ms after last night's runtime build. Looks correlated with attention kernel selection.
maya: :eyes: I see the same in Grafana for redwood-1.2 around 03:40 UTC. p95 also ~2x.
alex: Repro'd locally on a g4dn instance with seq_len=1024. p99 jumps when FlashAttention kernel is picked for causal longseq paths. image sha: abcdef12
tony: Did anything change in build flags or kerneltuner heuristics?
alex: Build pipeline added -DUSE_SDP_ATTENTION=1 and we bumped the kernel priority thresholds in kerneltuner yesterday. Suspect mixup between SDPA/Flash heuristics + quant path.
jamie: Can you paste the kernel selection trace from the runtime logs (/var/log/redwood/attn-select.log)?
alex: Pasted snippet below:
```
[2026-03-16T03:40:12Z] model=redwood-1.2 seq=1024 chosen_kernel=flashattn_v2 compile_flags=SDPA_ON
[2026-03-16T03:40:12Z] latency_ms=410 p99_window=60s
[2026-03-16T03:40:12Z] quant_path=true fallback_check=no
```
maya: That shows flashattn being selected even though SDPA was enabled at compile; looks like runtime selection prefers flash for that seq len. For quantized kernels, flash can regress in some kernels.
tony: Mitigations we can try quickly:
- revert compile flag in build (rollback image)
- runtime override via env REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE="sdpa>flash>cpu" on canary
- per-model config to force kernel: model.meta.force_kernel=sdpa
alex: Tony — can you apply the runtime override to pool-canary-1 and run a synthetic load?
sre-bot: deploy started: canary=pool-canary-1 user=tony id=deploy-5067891245
tony: Applied REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE on canary and ran synthetic job:
```
seq=1024 qps=50 model=redwood-1.2
before p99=420ms after p99=125ms
```
alex: :thumbsup: That confirms kernel selection is the culprit. Action items:
- Tony: promote override to the AcmeCorp pinned route and expand to affected pools
- Jamie: open PR to remove SDPA compile flag from next runtime build and add regression tests
- Maya: add a canary alert that fires when kernel-choice p99 delta > 30% vs baseline
jamie: I'll add a unit/regression test that runs quantized weights on seq 512/1024 and asserts p99 < 200ms, plus a CI gate.
alex: I'll update the support ticket and apply a temporary per-customer kernel pin until the build rollforward.
maya: Thanks everyone — good catch. We'll follow up in the incident board and keep the customer updated. :heart:
